# External input lists

Lists supplied from outside the project. They are inputs for building manifests; they are not frozen manifests.

| File | What | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `claytor2025_nonrotator_ticids.txt` | 23,332 unique TIC IDs, one per line (range 25063308–765470988). Rae: "Zach's list of TICIDs for non-rotators", i.e. the stars behind the training data of Claytor+2025. | From Zach Claytor via Rae, 2026-11-12. Original filename `smarts_star_ticids.txt`. That name suggests these may be the TESS stars whose light curves SMARTS used (as noise or injection hosts) rather than a vetted non-rotator sample. Confirm with Zach/the paper before treating every star as quiet (P27). |
